- Fast path to expansion: product team confirmed an integration milestone that increases likelihood of conversion.
- Competitive pressure: they have one other vendor in the process who is offering credits + pricing flexibility.

Request: need exec signoff for the $15k credit (>$10k threshold) and the discount term. Legal will use standard SOW; I attached the draft SOW and a usage snapshot from their test runs.

Irene —
Reviewed the ask. My recommendation is to split the difference but add tighter gates:
- Approve $10,000 free credits (applied to POC usage only)
- 15% discount on the first two billing cycles after conversion (not on one-off SOW work)
- Commit clause: customer must sign the commitment by 2027-09-30 and commit to at least $8k/mo for 3 months for the discount to apply
- Usage cap: credits cover up to 200k generated tokens; any overage billed at list

Reasoning: $15k is a little high versus pipeline quality. Approving $10k keeps the ask market-competitive and limits downside. Anything above $10k requires Vivek's approval; please escalate.
